purpose: Complete bounded development measurement on chapter-first pipeline, keeping non-generation and quality labels separate.
blocking_findings: One calculus case ends incomplete before any chapter node; final provider metrics were lost in this failure path.
Source gate incorrectly blocks chain-rule ordering because a function argument(0) is parsed as step0.
Some generated psychology applications do not establish the required behavior-consequence contingency or overclaim independence of memory functions.
Several model declines claim missing source despite distinct facts/procedures being available; technical citation labels leak into some prose.
comparison_limit: Old dev-v3 produced35/48 with the extraction-only pipeline; current dev-v4 produces30/48 after whole-chapter preparation. Prompt/validator/context changed together and model varies; this is not a single-variable accuracy or speed comparison.
